items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: Carnet, you'd see a Carnet tonight maybe with him.

ctx.x: Did they have a band there too or just piano?

Just a cafe band. A combination of lines. Carnet, you'd see a Carnet tonight maybe with him. Or Trumon tomorrow night you'd go and see a band or something else. Because Tony was featured. He was a star. I played at Tony's funeral.
